steps.npc: Oh, er, hello. What do you want?

options.text: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?

steps.player: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?

steps.npc: There's not much farming land around here. Only that little patch outside.

steps.player: Can you give me any advice on farming here in the desert?

steps.npc: Like I said, I only know about cactuses...

steps.player: Just tell me about cactuses, then.

steps.npc: First you have to weed the patch using a rake.

steps.player: Can you give me any other advice?

steps.npc: Not really. I've not done much farming recently.

steps.player: Well, can you at least sell me any gardening tools or seeds?

steps.npc: Sorry. They haven't been delivered yet.

options.text: So, what do you do here?

steps.player: So, what do you do here?

steps.npc: I'm going to set up a shop selling farming implements. That patch out there may be small, but it's all we've got.

options.text: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
options.condition: If the player has asked any of the Al Kharid merchants about Ali Morrisane:

steps.player: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...

steps.npc: Yes, he bought these tents and had them put up for us. He says he'll also get our goods in so we can start selling them soon.
I only know how to farm cactuses, so this spot is perfect.

steps.player: Maybe I should talk to him...

steps.npc: Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.

options.text: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
options.condition: If the player has asked Ellis, the Shop assistant, or the Shop keeper (possibly other Al Kharid merchants as well) about Ali Morrisane:

steps.player: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.

steps.npc: Now why would you think that?

steps.player: One of the shopkeepers told they were threatened by a man with a rake...

steps.npc: Those people just don't want us to succeed. Don't listen to them!
